description: Dark green and/or orange to yellow patterned rind with longitudinal ridges. Acorn-shaped, generally 4-7 inches long. Sweet, yellow-orange flesh inside. Belongs to the same species as summer squashes like zucchini and crookneck squash.

companions.notes: openfarm-crops-rescue lists this as a companion without indicating polarity; assumed 'good' per common convention
